$comment: CN/V20261019: CN-advanced-3.1.0, II.D-07 Hoopa V, PDF p45; II.E-13, PDF p59–60 (one-based). Effective Pokémon type-set replacement only. Printed types, attached Energy provision, Weakness and Resistance remain separate. Host filters applicable sources/targets; evidence fields never grant approval.

targetCard.description: 「身上放有这张卡牌的「银伴战兽GX」，会变为【超】宝可梦」: only affected Pokémon whose PRINTED top card matches (names, stages, tags; never a current type, which this layer produces).

sourceEnergy.description: 「只要这只宝可梦身上放有「驱劲能量 未来」」: only while the source Pokémon has an attached Energy card matching this selector (the physical card).

contextEffect.description: selection.context 「这只宝可梦，会变为与这只宝可梦身上附有的基本能量相同的属性（附有2种以上…则同时变为各种对应的属性）」 (attachedBasicEnergy, continuous, scope self) / 「…则在那个回合结束前，这只宝可梦的属性变为和附着的「基本能量卡」相同」 (eventEnergy, lasting, scope all): the host reads the types and replaces typesFrom with them — a continuous one whenever the board is read, a lasting one when it is created; with none to read there is no type change.

replacements.description: Already applicable entries. Runtime additionally rejects duplicate IDs and conflicting type SETS. Equivalent sets may use different array order; the host supplies no ordering priority.
